name: cloud-architecture-diagrams
description: Build editable cloud architecture diagrams (Azure/Microsoft, AWS, GCP) with official vendor icons, exported as both .excalidraw and .drawio. Bundles ~3,900 offline icons across AWS, Azure, GCP and the full Microsoft set (Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Fabric, M365, Intune, Entra). Supports text-to-diagram and recreate-from-image, plus native draw.io vector stencils for AWS/GCP.
